svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What the TMC5160A does
svg.desc: Capability map of the TMC5160A: Motion controller and homing (supported): Moves to a target or runs at a velocity on its own ramp; stops and latches the position at switches; STEP/DIR input (supported): Takes step pulses from your MCU instead, interpolated to 256 microsteps by MicroPlyer; Motor current (supported): Sets run and hold current from the motor rating and the sense resistor, and powers down at standstill; StealthChop2 and SpreadCycle (supported): Silent voltage-mode chopping at low speed, cycle-by-cycle current chopping at high speed; StallGuard2, CoolStep and DcStep (supported): Senses the load without a sensor: detects a stall, saves current at light load, slows under overload; Encoder input (supported): Counts an ABN incremental encoder and flags a deviation from the commanded position; Bridge and protection (guarded): Short, overtemperature and gate-drive settings; a wrong value can destroy the bridge; SPI chain and UART nodes (supported): Several chips on one SPI daisy chain or one single wire UART, each with its own address; OTP programming (not covered): One-time programmable defaults in the chip; the driver reads them and never programs them.
svg.text: One card per function of the chip, with how this driver covers it and the registers behind it.
